answer: Onyx bond decay: each identity locks a 120-credit onyx bond, losing 12 each epoch without a voyage leg. A leg is a key-signed trip filed at the oasis for 45; below 40 it retires, the rest burns. A rented leg bears another key, so both bonds burn. 1,000 fakes alive cost 45,000 per epoch against a 40,000 pool, plus 120,000 locked; idling sheds 12,000 per epoch, retiring them in 7 epochs. An honest agent files one leg, pays 45, keeps bond and share.
